title: El Consejo de los Dioses
summary: "El Consejo de los Dioses" by José Rizal is a play written in 1880. Written when Rizal was nineteen, the work depicts Olympian deities discussing Western literary standards. The play explores human desire for knowledge and establishes guidelines for Filipino speculative thought, becoming a reference text for literary criticism in the Philippines.
